description: This Java interface defines data access operations for Zone entities, including methods to list zones filtered by language and country.

classes.name: ZoneDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for retrieving Zone entities, extending generic DAO capabilities, with custom query methods for listing zones by language and country.

methods.name: listByLanguageAndCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Zone entities filtered by specified country and language.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Zone entities filtered by specified language.
